request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:GUARD

layers.text: Change three things only. The big biscuit shield becomes a thick slab of dark chocolate bar marked into square blocks #4a2412 with lighter #7a4526 edges. Its feet and the lowest quarter of its body are dipped in dark chocolate with a wavy edge. The pink frosting on its top becomes golden caramel #e0a040. Do not redraw anything else: keep the white marshmallow body, the face, the cheeks, the arms, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
